API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIEmergency Access ManagementGets all emergency access users for the specified customer.
Gets all emergency access users for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/emergencyAccess/users

Gets all emergency access users for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
pageId
string

The cursor that points to the end of the page of data that has been returned.

pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.
